text:
Type: tall six-door storage cabinet
Use: storing books, media, files and household items behind doors; living room, home office, dining room
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: white laminated board, flat matte doors, small plastic feet
Colors: pure white
Shape: tall wide rectangular block with a grid of six flush handleless doors in two columns, crisp straight edges, tiny feet, clean uniform front, large but calm visual weight
Feel: clean, orderly, quiet, neutral
Goes with: light wood, white walls, grey textiles, black accents; minimalist or Scandinavian living rooms and home offices

product.name: BEST
product.description: You can choose to use either the soft-closing or push-open function. The push-opener lets you open the doors with just a light push, while the soft-closing hinges makes sure they close silently and softly.
